goal: Implement parse_duration(text) in duration.py: convert strings like '1h30m' into seconds.
criteria: Supports the units h, m and s, each at most once and in this order (e.g. '2h', '45s', '1h5m10s', '90m'). Surrounding whitespace is ignored. Anything else (empty, unknown units, wrong order, repeated units) raises ValueError.
